sdn_note: In standard OpenFlow/Mininet networks, switches forward packets at Layer 2 without decrementing the IPv4 TTL field (unless explicit dec_ttl actions exist). Consequently, intermediate OpenFlow switches are transparent to standard traceroute; the destination host answers directly at Hop 1 via ICMP Port Unreachable. Authoritative multi-switch forwarding paths are determined by querying the SDN controller flow tables (see flow_inspector.py).
